This is the list of Kanji characters you need to learn for the Japanese Language Proficiency Test level N3. Click on each character for more details.


愛 (ai): love, affection


暗 (an): darkness, shade


馬 (ba): horse


番 (ban): turn, number in a series


晩 (ban): nightfall, night


抜 (batsu): slip out, extract


米 (bei): rice, metre


便 (ben): convenience, excrement


備 (bi): equip, preparation


美 (bi): beauty, beautiful


暮 (bo): evening, livelihood


望 (bou): ambition, hope, desire


亡 (bou): deceased, dying


忘 (bou): forget


忙 (bou): busy, occupied


部 (bu): section, portion


舞 (bu): dance, flit, circle


猫 (byou): cat


置 (chi): placement, put, set


値 (chi): price, cost, value


遅 (chi): slow, late, back


恥 (chi): shame, dishonor


直 (choku): straightaway, repair


調 (chou): tun
